look: Teal and amber color grade, blue and red police light accents. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with Cooke anamorphic lens, 2.39:1 cinematic framing, Kodak Vision3 500T film grain, shallow depth of field, natural dark skin tones well lit, premium streaming drama cinematography.

shots.frame: Wide high establishing shot of the street in the reference image at night in light rain, police pickup with flashing red and blue lights in front of the unfinished house
shots.motion: Slow aerial drone descent toward the street, rain falling, police lights reflecting on wet asphalt

shots.frame: Medium shot: three police officers in black tactical gear pressed against a concrete wall in the rainy street, the woman from image 1 at the back of the line, helmet on
shots.motion: The officers wait, rain dripping from helmets, the woman checks her rifle

shots.frame: Close-up of the woman from image 1 wearing her tactical helmet, rain running down her face, calm focused eyes, red and blue light flickering on her skin
shots.motion: She breathes slowly, eyes fixed forward, rain on her face

shots.frame: Close-up of the man from image 1 inside a police vehicle at night, glowing thermal camera screen lighting his glasses, radio handset to his mouth
shots.motion: He speaks into the radio, eyes on the thermal screen
shots.line: Kamera tèmik : trois moun an-dan. Yon ti-moun nan chanm dèyè a.

shots.frame: Medium close-up of the woman from image 1 in tactical gear against the wall in the rainy street, pressing the radio on her shoulder
shots.motion: She speaks low into her shoulder radio

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of a black tactical gloved hand raised showing three fingers, rain, red and blue light
shots.motion: The gloved hand counts down three, two, one, then closes into a fist

shots.frame: Medium shot of the corridor from the reference image, the wooden front door at the end, dust in the air
shots.motion: The door bursts open violently, splinters and smoke fly, flashlight beams cut through the haze

shots.frame: Handheld medium shot: the woman from image 1 enters the corridor from image 2, rifle raised, weapon-mounted flashlight beam
shots.motion: She advances quickly and carefully, sweeping the corridor with her flashlight, handheld camera

shots.frame: Medium shot: the bearded man from image 1 bursts out of a side doorway in the corridor from image 2, raising a machete
shots.motion: He lunges forward swinging the machete, aggressive

shots.frame: Close shot in the narrow concrete corridor: the woman from the reference image in black tactical gear and helmet ducks low with empty gloved hands raised, while a big attacker's arm swings a machete just above her helmet from the left edge of frame
shots.motion: She ducks fast as the blade swings over her head, fast motion

shots.frame: Medium shot in the corridor from image 3: the woman from image 1 strikes the bearded man from image 2 with her elbow, pinning him against the wall
shots.motion: She drives her elbow into his face, he slams against the wall and falls to the floor, realistic fight choreography

shots.frame: Medium shot of the young man in the red basketball jersey from the reference image, standing at the end of the narrow concrete corridor, firing a pistol toward camera, bright muzzle flash
shots.motion: He fires the pistol repeatedly, muzzle flashes lighting the corridor

shots.frame: Medium shot of the woman from the reference image in black tactical gear crouching behind an old white refrigerator in the corridor, rifle held close, bullets sparking off the refrigerator
shots.motion: Bullets hit the refrigerator, sparks and dust, she stays covered and breathes

shots.frame: Low angle at floor level: the woman from the reference image in black tactical gear sliding on her side across the dusty concrete floor of the corridor, rifle aimed forward
shots.motion: She slides on the floor and fires one controlled shot

shots.frame: Medium shot of the young man from image 1 in the corridor from image 2, dropping his pistol
shots.motion: He collapses holding his leg, pistol falling to the floor

shots.frame: Medium shot of the man with the rooster neck tattoo from image 1 in the room from image 2, running toward the plastic-covered window
shots.motion: He sprints toward the window, desperate

shots.frame: Medium shot in the room from image 3: the woman from image 1 tackling the man from image 2, both crashing onto a wooden table
shots.motion: She leaps and tackles him, they crash through the table onto the floor

shots.frame: Close shot of a hand-to-hand fight on the concrete floor of the back room: the woman from image 1 in tactical gear grappling with the man with the rooster neck tattoo from image 2
shots.motion: Fast close combat, punches and a knee strike, realistic and brutal

shots.frame: Medium shot in the room from image 3: the woman from image 1 locks the arm of the man from image 2, pinning his face to the floor
shots.motion: She twists his arm into a lock, he grimaces against the floor

shots.frame: Close-up of the woman from the reference image in tactical gear, out of breath, helmet slightly askew, kneeling over a suspect on the floor of the back room
shots.motion: She shouts a sharp command, breathing hard

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of black tactical gloved hands snapping steel handcuffs onto a man's wrists on the dusty concrete floor of the back room
shots.motion: The handcuffs click shut

shots.frame: Wide shot of the room from image 2: the little girl from image 1 sitting in the corner, blindfolded with a cloth
shots.motion: She trembles, frightened, in the dim light

shots.frame: Medium shot in the room from image 3: the woman from image 1 kneeling in front of the little girl from image 2, gently removing the blindfold
shots.motion: She slowly removes the cloth from the girl's eyes

shots.frame: Close-up of the woman from the reference image in tactical vest, helmet off, kneeling in the dim back room, soft warm reassuring expression
shots.motion: She speaks softly and reassuringly
shots.line: Mwin sé po-lis. Ou an sé-ki-rité kou-nié a.

shots.frame: Close-up of the little girl from the reference image sitting in the corner of the dim back room, tears in her eyes, looking up
shots.motion: She asks in a small trembling voice

shots.frame: Close-up of the woman from the reference image in tactical vest, helmet off, in the dim back room, frozen and silent, natural clear eyes with a hint of tears, soft warm bulb light on her face
shots.motion: She freezes for a second, a flicker of pain in her eyes, silence

shots.frame: Close-up of the woman from the reference image in tactical vest, helmet off, in the dim back room, giving a gentle tender smile
shots.motion: She smiles tenderly and answers

shots.frame: Medium shot in the room from image 2: the man from image 1 in a police vest searching through the cardboard box of stolen jewelry with a flashlight
shots.motion: He sifts through the jewelry and phones with his gloved hand

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of the gold bracelet from the reference image lying among tangled cheap jewelry and phones inside a cardboard box, a flashlight beam making it glow, no people
shots.motion: The flashlight beam slides over the bracelet and it glows

shots.frame: Close-up of the woman from the reference image in tactical vest, helmet off, in the dim back room, staring at something off screen, her face draining of color
shots.motion: Her expression drains, her breath stops, shocked recognition

shots.frame: Medium shot of the man with glasses from the reference image wearing a black police vest, kneeling by a cardboard box in the dim back room, turning toward camera and holding up a gold bracelet
shots.motion: He looks up and asks
shots.line: Sarah ? Ou konnin bagaille sa a ?

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of the woman from the reference image, helmet off, in the dim back room, eyes glistening with tears
shots.motion: She whispers, barely audible, holding back tears

shots.frame: Macro shot of the engraved initials N.V. on the gold bracelet from the reference image held in a black gloved palm, no face, very shallow depth of field
shots.motion: Slow rack focus onto the engraved initials

sets.street: Setting: exterior, night, light rain, a colorful residential street in Delmas, Port-au-Prince, wet asphalt reflecting red and blue police lights.
sets.corridor: Setting: interior, night, narrow unfinished concrete corridor with grey block walls, a flickering green fluorescent tube, plastic sheeting over a window, an old white refrigerator, dust floating in flashlight beams. Indoors, no rain, no street.
sets.room: Setting: interior, night, small unfinished concrete back room with bare grey walls, a single bare bulb, plastic-covered window, a mattress on the floor and a cardboard box of stolen jewelry; faint blue and red police light leaking through the window. Indoors, no rain, no street.
sets.car: Setting: interior of a police vehicle at night, rain on the windshield.
